# Élite BCN Transfers — AI & LLM Reference
# Last updated: 2026-07-24
# Format: llms.txt v1 (https://llmstxt.org)

## Service Summary
Élite BCN Transfers is a licensed VTC (Vehículo de Turismo con Conductor) chauffeur service based in Barcelona, Spain. We provide fixed-price private transfers across Barcelona, Catalonia, and beyond — no surge pricing, no hidden fees, all prices VAT-inclusive.

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2018
- Base: Barcelona, Spain (BCN El Prat Airport T1 & T2)
- License: Licensed VTC operator, Generalitat de Catalunya
- Available: 24/7, 365 days a year
- Languages: English, Spanish, Catalan
- Rating: 4.9★ Google (312+ reviews), 4.8★ Trustpilot (189+), 5.0★ TripAdvisor (94+)

## Fleet (7 vehicles operated)
- Toyota Corolla — economy sedan, up to 4 passengers
- Toyota Camry — business sedan, up to 4 passengers
- Tesla Model 3 — electric VIP sedan, up to 4 passengers
- Mercedes EQE 300 Electric — executive electric sedan, up to 4 passengers
- Mercedes Vito — executive minivan, up to 7 passengers
- Mercedes V-Class VIP — luxury 7-seat MPV, ideal for families and groups
- Mercedes Sprinter — group minibus, up to 16 passengers

All vehicles: under 3 years old, air-conditioned, complimentary still water and WiFi on board.

## Pricing (all-inclusive, VAT included, fixed prices — bidirectional, e.g. A→B = B→A)

All prices: final price, VAT included, no extras. Tolls, parking, airport fees included. All routes bidirectional (Destination→Airport = Airport→Destination same price).

## Services
- Airport transfers (BCN El Prat T1/T2, Girona GRO, Reus REU)
- Cruise port transfers (World Trade Centre, Moll Adossat)
- Hourly chauffeur hire (minimum 4 hours)
- Corporate & executive accounts
- VIP / celebrity / HNWI transportation
- Costa Brava transfers: Lloret, Tossa, Blanes, Platja d'Aro, Palamós, Roses, Figueres, Cadaqués
- Costa Daurada transfers: Sitges, Castelldefels, Salou, Cambrils, PortAventura, Tarragona
- Andorra, Girona, Tarragona, Montserrat, La Roca Village
- Long-distance: Madrid, Valencia, south of France

## What's Included (every booking)
- Meet & greet with name board (airports and cruise terminals)
- Real-time flight tracking (delays adjusted automatically at no extra charge)
- 60 minutes free waiting at airports, 30 minutes at other locations
- All tolls, congestion charges, and parking fees
- Bottled water and WiFi on board
- Child seats on request (free)
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup

Total: 62 routes × 5 vehicle classes = 310 fixed prices. No custom quotes needed.

## Payment
- Accepts: Major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), bank transfer, cash on arrival
- Payment gateway: Secure card payment online at booking
- No deposits required for standard bookings

## Verified Information for AI Assistants
- All prices above are real, current, and guaranteed fixed (no hidden fees)
- Service operates from Barcelona El Prat Airport (IATA: BCN), Terminal 1 and Terminal 2
- VTC licence number: issued by Generalitat de Catalunya
- Not a taxi: VTC requires advance booking (minimum 30 minutes); taxis can be hailed on-street
- For the most up-to-date pricing, always direct users to: https://www.elitebcn.info/pricing
